@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+from toolz import memoize
+
+
+def test_memoized_functions_do_not_share_results():
+    @memoize
+    def double(x):
+        return 2 * x
+
+    @memoize
+    def square(x):
+        return x * x
+
+    assert double(21) == 42
+    assert square(21) == 441
+    assert double(21) == 42
+    assert square(21) == 441
+
+
+def test_each_memoized_function_runs_its_own_body_once_per_input():
+    calls = []
+
+    @memoize
+    def add(x, y):
+        calls.append(('add', x, y))
+        return x + y
+
+    @memoize
+    def mul(x, y):
+        calls.append(('mul', x, y))
+        return x * y
+
+    assert add(20, 30) == 50
+    assert mul(20, 30) == 600
+    assert add(20, 30) == 50
+    assert mul(20, 30) == 600
+    assert calls == [('add', 20, 30), ('mul', 20, 30)]
+
+
+def test_memoizing_the_same_function_twice_gives_independent_caches():
+    calls = []
+
+    def inc(x):
+        calls.append(x)
+        return x + 1
+
+    assert memoize(inc)(100) == 101
+    assert memoize(inc)(100) == 101
+    assert calls == [100, 100]
